correctness.rationale: Direct construction of the even-weight 5-bit Clebsch graph, its full 1920 automorphisms and all 352 faces. Binary augmented ranks (1,15,65,64,16) attain rigorous chain-complex bounds in characteristic zero, yielding only reduced rational H2=31. Every one of 1920 exact characters agrees under two different signed-face formulas. Walsh Fourier inversion gives translation multiplicities 6,3,1; their three disjoint S5-orbit supports yield a rational decomposition, and the complete character inner product 3 proves each of the three summands absolutely irreducible. Translation averaging agrees with Lambda^2 standard S5 character. Finite quotient rational averaging then proves the two stated quotient homology classifications. Dependency-free verifier and output supplied.

value.rationale: A natural highly symmetric strongly regular graph already has known 31-dimensional ordinary homology. The complete rational automorphism representation is materially finer: all 31 dimensions split as three intrinsic absolutely irreducible modules with nonuniform Fourier orbit multiplicities, including an S5 exterior square in the quotient by translations. This predicts a genuine six-dimensional translation-quotient homology versus full quotient rational acyclicity, which cannot be obtained from Betti numbers alone. It is a natural complete symmetry calculation, not an arbitrary small slice; it motivates further integral and equivariant studies.
